data.narrative:
QuantumDiamonds is a Seed-stage quantum computing company founded by Kevin Berghoff and Fleming Bruckmaier. The quantum computing sector comprises 3 public and 8 private peers, including Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion. The company has raised €7M in seed capital plus a €152M facility commitment.

A stage-progression methodology is applicable, using the €7M raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression in frontier tech. This method yields an implied valuation of €18M. Peer-median analysis is not applicable: while the quantum computing sector contains 6 comparables, insufficient same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier peers exist to support a robust median calculation. A cross-sector peer median would introduce unacceptable noise given the specialized nature of quantum hardware development.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €15M to €20M, with €18M as the median point. This range reflects a single methodology, creating material uncertainty around the estimate. Key risks include: execution risk on the €152M facility commitment, which may not fully translate to equity value; the absence of near-peer comparables with disclosed valuations; and stage-specific uncertainty inherent in Seed-round capital structures. Any refinement would require either disclosed valuations from comparable Seed-stage quantum companies or additional financial metrics from QuantumDiamonds itself.
